items.title: When a young woman is raped by two friends, her small town turns against her
items.description: A local footy star and his mate are convicted of raping their friend. In the tiny town of Balmoral, where the footy club reigns, the town makes it clear whose story they believe.

items.title: How a window opened for IS-linked Australians to leave Syria
items.description: After holding a large swathe of autonomous territory that included two detention camps, Kurdish-led forces are now reluctantly handing over control to Syrian government forces, following their successful military offensive.

items.title: The dirty little secret economists never want to mention
items.description: The theory goes that if you have just the right amount of workers on the unemployment scrap heap, you can keep inflation in check. The problem is that no-one knows exactly what the magic unemployment rate is.

items.title: The US Supreme Court's takedown of Trump's tariffs, explained
items.description: The ruling on tariffs is a hugely consequential decision that has infuriated the president, who is now looking for workarounds.

items.title: NASA boss blasts Boeing and space agency for botched Starliner flight
items.description: A bungled Boeing mission that left two astronauts stranded on the International Space Station for nine months has been criticised by NASA's new boss.

items.title: Video shows moment man charged with hate crime allegedly rammed synagogue
items.description: It's alleged the 32-year-old rammed a ute into the gates of the Brisbane Synagogue on Margaret Street on Friday night.

items.title: After more than 50 years, humans are set to return to the Moon
items.description: NASA's Artemis II mission may launch in early March. If successful, it will be the first time humans have flown beyond the Moon in more than 50 years.

items.title: Anna Murdoch-Mann, ex-wife of Rupert Murdoch, dies aged 81
items.description: The author, journalist and philanthropist was Rupert Murdoch's "active partner" in his media empire News Corp over their 31-year marriage.

items.title: Money, money, money: Child abuse may not spur action, but money does

items.title: Zempilas has three H's in mind. There's one more he'll want to avoid

items.title: Yoon Suk Yeol's insurrection conviction completes a scandalous downfall
items.description: Former South Korean president Yoon Suk Yeol's sentence for insurrection comes after a tumultuous era of shamanism, Chanel bags and conspiracy theories.

items.title: I had a miscarriage over the summer. It was nothing like I expected
items.description: My understanding of miscarriage was built on a handful of Hollywood representations and snatches of stories I'd read. Outside of this, I had few reference points.

items.title: 'Class clown' says satirical AI videos are an extension of his Aussie humour

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of Ninja Turtles, Netflix and nagging pain
items.description: Every question has only two options: One is right and the other is wrong. You have an even chance of guessing correctly each time.

items.title: Quick hits: Another brutal curling barb as Lindsey Vonn goes 'bionic'
items.description: Swedish curler Oskar Eriksson hits Canadian nemesis Marc Kennedy with his most devastating barb yet as Lindsey Vonn shares an update on her recovery. Here are the quick hits from day 14 at the Winter Olympics.

items.title: Anna almost died in Tokyo from a disease she thought she was vaccinated against

items.title: The courtroom sketch is as old as court itself. Now, it's rapidly evolving

items.title: The volunteer team keeping an often-invisible global workforce afloat
items.description: In a 109-year-old building wedged between mirrored high-rises in Melbourne's CBD, a volunteer team supports a little-known workforce that spends months at a time at sea.

items.title: Pacific Islands cut Russia's 'shadow tankers' loose

items.title: Should Labor have its own reshuffle?

items.title: 'Scarecrow of the sky' in full flight to protect Australian fruit and almond crops

items.title: The reason why other farmers often ask Frank if his sheep are still alive

items.title: Even if it's a Labor landslide, there's a lot to learn from SA's upcoming election
